The challenge

Regional decisions about land, water and transport shape daily life for decades. This section tests headings, paragraphs and lists from the block editor.

  • Mapping where risk and growth overlap
  • Agreeing shared targets across departments
  • Publishing the data so others can build on it

What we are doing

Working with provincial planners and communities to turn the plan into funded projects.
